bias.en: Bearish, bouncing · back above the 100-day average
bias.zh: 偏空反弹 · 重回 100 日均线上方

read.en: Marvell rose 1.8% on Oct 21 to $244.76 on light volume, between $237.80 and $250.12. It is above the falling 5-day ($238.3) and rising 100-day ($241.9) and 200-day ($178.2) averages, but below the falling 10-day ($252.1) and rising 30-day ($253.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($266.30), and RSI is 47.
read.zh: Marvell 10月21日上涨 1.8%，收于 $244.76，成交清淡，盘中区间 $237.80–250.12。股价位于下行的 5 日（$238.3）以及上行的 100 日（$241.9）和 200 日均线（$178.2）上方，但低于下行的 10 日（$252.1）和上行的 30 日均线（$253.5）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$266.30），RSI 为 47。

read.en: The close reclaimed the 100-day average ($241.9) that capped Oct 20, and the high cleared the $246.6 Oct 19 high before fading. Resistance is $250.1 (day's high), then $252–253.5 (10 and 30-day averages) and $266.3 (SAR). Support is $238–242 (5 and 100-day), then $226.5 (Oct 16 and 20 lows) and $200.6. A close above $253.5 would open $266; a close below $226.5 would open $200.6.
